chunks: Wahb ibn Hafs narrated to me, from Isḥāq ibn Jarīr, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Bakr, and Abū Khālid al-Kābulī were among the trustworthy associates of ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام. He said: And my mother was among those who believed, were Godwary, and did good.
And Allah loves the doers of good.

He said: And my mother said: My father said: O Umm Farwah, I surely supplicate to Allah for the sinful ones among our Shiʿah a thousand times during the day and the night, because we, in what befalls us of afflictions, are patient upon what we know of the reward, while they are patient upon what they do not know.

key_terms.أَدْعُو: I supplicate and call upon Allah
key_terms.اتَّقَتْ: she was Godwary and exercised taqwa
key_terms.الثَّوَابِ: the divine reward for patience and endurance
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shiʿah, the followers devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.مُذْنِبِي: those among them who commit sins

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام describe the trusted companions of Imam Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn عليه السلام and the Imam’s du'a for his Shiʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith praises several trusted figures connected to Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and also commends the piety and excellence of the Imam’s mother. It further conveys the compassion of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام toward their Shiʿah, showing that the Imam repeatedly made du'a for their sinful members and highlighted the virtue of patient endurance.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Ahmad, from Ibrahim Bin Al Hassan who said, ‘Wahab Bin Hafs narrated to me, from Is’haq Bin Jareer who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It was so that Saeed Bin Al-Musayyab, and Al-Qasim Bin Muhammad Bin Abul Bakr, and Abu Khalid Al-Kabuly were from the reliable ones of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>. And it was so that my<sup>asws</sup> mother was from the ones who believed, and was pious and a good doer, and
[2:195] surely Allah loves the doers of good’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And my<sup>asws</sup> mother said that my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Umm Farwa! I I<sup>asws</sup> tend to supplicate to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for the sins of our<sup>asws</sup> Shias during the day and the night, a thousand times, because we<sup>asws</sup>, regarding what we<sup>asws</sup> face from the deprivations. We<sup>asws</sup> observe patience upon what we<sup>asws</sup> know from the Rewards, and they are being patient upon what they are unaware of’.
en.sarwar: was born in the year eighty three AH. He passed away in the month of Shawwal in the year one hundred forty eight at the age of sixty five. He was buried in al-Baqi‘ cemetery in Madina in the grave yard where his father and grandfather and al-Hassan ibn Ali were buried. His mother was ’Umm Farwa daughter of al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ibn abu Bakr and her mother was ’Asma’ daughter of ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Bakr.
